subject: ddl: avoid sysvar drift in admin check before drop (#65972)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs parent: `DROP TABLE` precheck now runs `admin check table` using a single session from DDL’s own internal session pool and toggles/restores `tidb_enable_fast_table_check` on that same session, avoiding sysvar drift/nondeterminism from per-call restricted-SQL internal sessions; adds `(*sess.Pool).Destroy` to discard a session on sysvar-change failure and adds targeted regression/unit tests. No remaining Blocker/High issues found in DDL correctness/consistency/metadata/concurrency within the touched areas; later history up to `upstream/master` does not further modify this logic.
